topic: Fleet TUI dogfooding friction — verified cockpit/daemon findings + work items
notes:
Origin: dogfooding `bro fleet` by having an MM orchestrator bro drive the cockpit (via tmux) to build closeout Phase 4/5. The run was aborted by daemon/cockpit defects — but surfaced real issues. Findings sifted (verified vs. the bro's own misdiagnosis). Raw FLEET-FRICTION notes live under thread-c38e005d.

RESOLVED:
- [P0] glob_match exponential-backtracking daemon wedge — FIXED + deployed (commit e59bdd1). Recursive matcher (src/orchestration/mcp.rs) hot-looped on a multi-* tool-filter pattern while holding a lock → stalled all bbox_notes/thread/knowledge ops for minutes + hung in-process agents. Replaced with iterative two-pointer glob + regression test. Same wedge class as thread-de03a2c5 Note 5, different code path the hardened_walk fix (64fd627) never covered.

OPEN cockpit work items (verified):
- [P1] Dispatch composer: pasting a multi-line prompt submits one dispatch per LF (16 phantom agents spawned). Need bracketed-paste detection → soft-newlines, or a set_input keybinding (set_input exists at fleet_tui.rs:654, no binding).
- [P1] No bulk-cancel / prune in the cockpit — can't stop a runaway dispatch queue; operator must drop to MCP/interrupt per-task.
- [P1] In-process starvation (architectural): fleet agents run in-process in blackboxd, so a dispatch storm starves the operator's own cockpit/driver. Consider out-of-process agent workers or pool/priority isolation.
- [P2] /closeout not discoverable from the AgentsList (roster) zone slash menu or help overlay — only visible after zooming into SingleAgent.
- [P2] Finished-agent rows show "—" for report and model columns — visibility gap for "what did this agent produce / on what model".

NOT bugs (recorded so they aren't re-investigated): "tmux server died" (bro misread a capture error on its own isolated socket — server was alive) and "96% CPU idle daemon" (was the in-process agents'/glob-loop's real load, not an idle spin).

FIXED + validated (bro-cli, branch beta/blackbox-v2, not yet committed/installed):

- [P1] Dispatch composer paste → mass-dispatch — RESOLVED. Enabled crossterm bracketed paste (EnableBracketedPaste/DisableBracketedPaste in both terminal entry points: run_tui_cockpit + run_tui_inner_inline) and added an Event::Paste arm in poll_tui_input → handle_paste/splice_paste that normalizes CRLF/CR→LF and splices the whole paste into the composer at the cursor as soft newlines (no dispatch-per-LF). Added pure-fn regression test splice_paste_keeps_multiline_as_one_buffer. tmux-mcp smoke (paste-text = bracketed paste, real prod daemon): a 5-line paste landed as ONE composer buffer; footer stayed "20 agents — 0 active" (zero phantom dispatches). The original 16-phantom storm is still visible in the roster as the Interrupted(16) bucket — vivid before/after.
- [P2] /closeout not discoverable from roster — RESOLVED. Removed the `if app.zone == Zone::SingleAgent` guard in run_local_slash (selected_agent() already falls back to the roster cursor; daemon managed-worktree guard fails closed on a bad selection), added /closeout to the roster/default zone_slash_commands menu, and added a /closeout line to the Roster + SingleAgent help overlays. tmux smoke: typing `/` in the roster now shows "/closeout fold the selected worktree back to…" in the /commands menu.

DEPLOY NOTE: these are bro-cli (the `bro` binary, ~/.local/bin/bro 9.9M), NOT blackboxd. The daemon does not carry these fixes; only `bro` needs rebuild+reinstall.

ENV GOTCHA (not a product defect): baseline `cargo check -p bro-cli` first failed with phantom non-exhaustive-match errors naming CloseoutPhase::FetchTarget/ResetTarget + CloseoutErrorClass::ResetFailed + CloseoutOutcome::Recovered — variants that exist nowhere in the current source. Stale incremental rmeta for bro-protocol (working tree was switched/reverted without a recompile). `touch crates/bro-protocol/src/*.rs` + recheck → clean. Worth a guard: a stale-cache check or `cargo check` in a clean target before trusting baseline build state.

STILL OPEN (unchanged): model/report "—" for finished/reloaded agents (needs transport-shape/persistence work in model_from_events; brodex/Responses events likely don't carry a top-level `model`), cockpit bulk-cancel/prune (needs worker cancellation tokens for in-flight dispatches), in-process starvation (architectural, daemon-side), bro_prune MCP surface mismatch.

RESOLVED — extracted + consolidated 2026-06-09 into the focused residual set (alongside its sibling thread-c38e005d). Reconciled against current beta/blackbox-v2.

This thread's verified items are now LANDED: glob exponential-backtracking daemon wedge (P0, e59bdd1); dispatch composer paste→mass-dispatch (bracketed paste); /closeout roster discoverability; model/report "—" (daemon-owned roster cache). In-process starvation remains an accepted architectural stance (operator: in-process is a deliberate forcing function — fix concurrency to correctness, see thread-935b467d), not a bug to "resolve" via a process boundary.

Surviving residual (bro_prune MCP surface mismatch and any cockpit-vs-MCP disposition drift) folded into thread-4719ad45 (cockpit polish) / thread-935b467d (control-plane) as appropriate. New focused threads: thread-935b467d (daemon control-plane), thread-24220225 (harness ergonomics), thread-c0ac4d45 (supervision tuning), thread-4719ad45 (cockpit polish).
